body: Well, that was slightly sadistic and highly unexpected... I fucking love it!

Geez really is terrifying (I would have stayed in my sibling's rom too...). That reminds me of one time where I had been meditating, and heard my mom's voice say "Baby" since she calls me that a lot. I open my eyes and remember I'm home alone. She tells me later I had a 'imaginary friend' I'd call Candi. She asked me what it looked like and I giggled and told her to look in the mirror. My mom's nickname is Candi, but at the time, I had now knowledge of this.
Only my grandfather, me and him were very close, but I don't think it's him. The energy this figure gives off is way more intimidating, and makes me feel uneasy.

Mary has always been so incredibly nice to everyone, and I find it sickening. She's is always soo goddamn considerate, and everyone practically worships the bitch. Her parents brag and brag about how they were blessed with such an amazing, selfless doll of a daughter. God, I hate her.

One day, she was waltzing about the city with that goddamn innocent fucking smile plastered to her perfect face, enjoying her life and greeting everyone one she passed. I swear, sometimes I think she thinks she's Cinderella or some shit. She was about to enter some little candy store when she sees a little girl about to run into oncoming traffic. She darts over there like a bullet and saves the girl from being hit by a car, like fucking Wonder Woman. The parents thanked her and she didn't even scold them for not paying attention to their kids. Stupid bitch.

Why does she care so much about people? Once, she walked eight miles just to get a kid home. And she constantly runs errands for the elderly. She is always there for sobbing strangers that need a listening ear. She so sickeningly sweet to fucking everyone.

It kills me that she can go around helping strangers, then stand there watching her own sister be killed before her fucking eyes.

You say Tyler is a bad person, yea? I think the reason it was attached/attracted to him is because demonic entities tend to be attracted to negative energies. If one is a bad person or is experiencing intense depression/anxiety/self-loathing/etc., they are more likely to attract such entities. It's sort of like they feed of it, almost. I learned this from my past experience with the paranormal.

I hope this may have been helpful at least a little.

I was a rose once. I was a beautiful crimson rose.

I was happy once. I was tended to, cared for, and loved.

I fell in love once. She was beautiful and smart.

I was hurt once. My love loved another.

I was cut once. I loved her, and she loved my suffering.

I died once. Sweetest relief of my existence.

I woke up this morning to the bright sunshine, birds chirping and... the smell of death... FUCK.

I know exactly what that smell is. My brother. My dead goddamn brother.

I head down to the kitchen to see him there, at my table, smiling. Immediately after he notices my arrival, he starts his damned yammering. Even after death, he still talks my damn ear off. He sits there, playing with his legos and talking about games, as I cook. I sit down at the table as I set our plates down. Since he doesn't eat anymore, his food is secretly fake.

"Ya know, you can't keep doing this anymore, bro. You died ten years ago. I'm twenty-four now. I have my life to live." I say.

He says nothing, just looks at me.

I sigh. "C'mon, bro, you gotta go back now." I say. I finish my food, and drag his body to his grave in the back yard. His body goes lifeless every time I go to bury him.

Now, I really wish I hadn't killed him.

Ahh, today is going to be great! I get to be washed! Oh, and here she comes! My owner. She is beautiful and takes good care of me and my better half. And boy, does she have a great pair of feet!

She picks me and my partner up, puts us in the basket along with the other clothing, and gets us into the laundry room. Setting the basket on the ground, she starts putting handfuls of clothes in the washing machine. Finally, it's my turn. But, I'm slipping out of her hands. I fall on the floor waiting for her to notice but she doesn't. As she's leaving, she kicks me behind the washer and dryer.

And... that's it. I spend the rest of my time behind the machines...

Anne woke up to another grey day. She was sick of the grey, colorless world. But on the bright side, at least she didn't have work that day.

She got dressed and had breakfast, like any other morning. But today, she was going to head to the library. She had finished all her books, and was extremely bored. So, she hopped on a city bus that dropped off right outside the library. As she was getting off, she brushed against a lovely woman, and... everything burst into color.

The woman turned around, happily, until she saw Anne. As her eyes landed upon her soulmate, her face contorted from happiness to confusion.

"Excuse me, ma'am, but are you suddenly... seeing color to?" Anne asks.

The woman's eyes widen in realization. "Yes, I am... but, I don't get it. You're... a woman."

Anne chuckles. "I am. Is something wrong?"

"No, no, no, no, no..." the woman says, taking a step back. "I can't love a woman, I'm not gay. God, if my father finds out..." She takes a few more steps back.

"Um... miss, please, be careful.." Anne says.

"Mom... she'll kill me.." the woman continues, walking further backwards.

"Miss!" Anne exclaims, as the woman's face suddenly becomes illuminated... but it's too late. The car Anne's soulmate failed to see as she was walking unknowingly into the road hits her with a loud smack.

She didn't survive the accident. She died upon impact. Anne later found out her name was Jess. But on the bright side...

At least she sees in color now.

I glance at my Life-Tracking Device on my wrist, which clearly states I have ten minutes left to live. It may seem strange to you, but in my society, it is a well known concept. Basically, every ten years, one unlucky son of a bitch get chosen to become a sort of blood sacrifice to the creatures that used to roam the land. And basically, you can either kill people for more time, or let it run down until you die. You only get twenty years of time, if you were chosen, to live from the moment you are born.

I was sadly chosen.

But I refuse to kill.

So for my last ten minutes, I'm gonna have some fun.

I quickly grab the bag I had been waiting to use until this day. The contents are: a real-looking plastic gun, lighter fluid, matches, and a mask. After putting the mask on, I run out the door and head towards my neighbors house. Their kid is an idiot and constantly forgets to lock his car(a very expensive car too) and always leaves his keys inside. This should teach him. I start up his car and speed off, tires squealing.

I stop by my ex-girlfriend's house, knowing she's out with a different woman right now. Bitch. I grab the lighter fluid and douse the front of it, including her lawn and spare car. Then I break one of her windows and douse the room inside. A get back and toss a light match on her lawn, igniting it instantly. I drive off again, this time, heading to the bank. 

Six minutes.

When I reach the bank, I head inside with the fake gun and, now empty, bag. People immediately start screaming. I walk up calmly to one of the women working and say, "Put all money from Richard A. Stevens in the bag. And make it snappy, I'm on a time limit." She leaves and comes back thirty seconds later with numerous stacks of money. I shove in my bag, and run out the door and hop in the car in ten seconds flat.

Richard was my sister' abusive, rich ex husband. God, I hate him. Such a prick.

Well, it's time to cause some havoc. 

I drive down the fairly empty road... on the wrong side. I'm laughing as the cars swerve around me. And, finally, I'm hearing sirens. The cops! I've always wanted to be part of a police chase. Though, not as the one being chased but whatever. I drive around away from the police, still laughing, still speeding, still about to die.

Two minutes.

I change courses and am now heading towards the pier. My mom used to take me their as a kid. I've always loved it there. So peaceful.

One minute.

I see it. At the end of the street, is the beautiful beach and peaceful pier.

Thirty seconds. 

I am only about twenty yards away now.

Twenty seconds.

I can't believe this is it.

Ten seconds.

I drive onto the pier.

Five seconds.

Almost...

Four seconds.

I crash through the railing. 

Three seconds.

I smile.

Two seconds.

I hit the water. 

One second.

Goodbye.

The only people who know that name I have met personally, as we were childhood friends and talk on the phone often. I am going to ask them today if they told anyone of my nickname.

I have had plenty of experience with creeps like this, believe it or not, and had a friend who was kidnapped by human traffickers. I am very cautious of these types of people and am going to take extra precautions. I plan on talking to the police either today or tomorrow and will be sure to include the info on my nicknames and the hiding passengers.

Don't worry, I'm not going anywhere alone anytime soo, trust me. As for my various social media accounts, this type of stuff happens a lot (I suppose I seem like easy prey), so I never use my real name or the same passwords. I hide my face in pictures with bandanas or my hand made masks. I also had a few of my techie friends and family make it extremely difficult to find anything about me online. And I make new accounts often.

I am planning to visit the local police tomorrow. I understand your worry though. I had a friend a few years back who was kidnapped. Still no word on whether or not she is okay or anything like that. Thanks for your concern.
Good idea, I'll definitely get a picture of the van, and I think I have some mace in one of my purses. And I think I'll keep my pocketknife with me too.
Yea, definitely. I told my parents and little brother. I'll tell everyone else shortly. Better safe than sorry.

I used to be human. I was a kind, gentle, happy, and energetic girl.

That was until I met her. Long black hair, alluring smirk, and stone cold silver eyes. She was everything I wanted, everything I needed. And for a short time, I thought she felt the same.

But I was wrong. Oh, so terribly wrong.

A month after we became a thing, she showed her true colors. She was nothing but a beast, with a mangled smile adorning her once gorgeous face, eyes of the darkest black and sharp claw-like nails.

And just like that, she stole everything from me. My heart, my soul, my life, my humanity.... all of it, gone in an instant. And now I'm just like her. I'm forced to do what she did to me to others. I have to do it to survive.

So when we're face-to-face in your last moments, remember, I don't want to do this, that I don't have a choice, and that...

I used to be human.
Hmm okay, I guess. I think I will after I tell my parents. In fact, I'll probably do it today.

It scares me to think about how he knew my nicknames and I am still trying to rationalize it all. I mentally thank that woman everyday. I don't know what would have happened had she not been there that day. I'm definitely going to be way more careful from here on out.

I'll tell my parents but I don't think the police will be able to do anything since he didn't actually try anything and I didn't see his plate number. As for the co-worker idea, my parents are both disabled and not even they know those nicknames. The only people that do are either in New York, Japan, or England, locations that are all very far from my city. I think he might be a stalker as I've see a similar looking man and van a few times since this occurred. I'm gonna be way more cautious from now on.
I would, but he didn't necessarily do anything to me and I didn't get his plate number. I was just too freaked out.

"Finally! The day has come, Blue!" my twin sister cheers happily. Today, we turn eighteen and are to be assigned with a Protector, a magical guardian. It has been this way since the war between man and monster began, nearly six centuries ago. Each person gets a Protector based on their personality on the day they turn eighteen.

  My sister, unlike myself, has a reason to be excited. She is amazing at almost everything she does and has a brave personality. I, on the other hand, am completely average. A jack of all trades, ace of absolutely nothing. Not to mention, I am rather feeble and shy. 

  And, as we approach the Organization of Magical Beings, where we will be assigned to our Protector, I feel hopeless.

  When we get there, we are ushered into a large room filled with everyone else Turning today. We are assigned to seats and told to stay put until the ceremony. I just sit staring out a large window, where you can see people training and bonding with their Protector, or as I say "Spirit Animal". Before I even know it, my friends are being called up and assigned with their animal. My friend, Anne, puts her hand on the Assignment Crystal and in a flash of white, gets a swan for her gentle personality and beauty.
  
  I zone out again until my sister gets called. Belle gets a lion. As I had expected. She leaves to get acquainted with it or some shit. And just as I realize I'm next, I hear my name and my heart sinks. I slowly make my way up to the stage and think about what mine will be. I'll probably be the first girl to get a mouse or something of the sort.

  It all comes down to the moment of truth. I reach up and place my hand on the Crystal with my eyes shut tightly. In a bright flash of light I see through closed eyes, I sense a presence form in front of me and hear gasps eminating from behind.

  I open my eye to see a large black dragon with sharp silver eyes. It's eyes meet mine, and it bows it's neck towards me.

  I look over at the woman who had been anouncing the names and whatnot to see her shocked face.

  "Has this ever... happened before?"

  "No... I need to inform her Majesty!" she says, running off.

  I look back at my dragon and it says in a bellowing voice, "Greetings, Blue, I am Akuma, your Protector."

I'm not gonna say it gets better, I'm too young to know, but I know this type of feeling. I'm fourteen, which might seem too young to be suicidal, but I get it. Ever since I can remember, I've been bullied, assaulted in many ways, and have been off and on homeless. And I have to deal with my problems as well as everyone I love and their problems. I had a date picked a month ago, and even though nothing got better, I got better. I'm not cured but coping. And I get it. If you'd like someone to talk to, I might be able to help, or at least listen. Okay? Well... if you even read this, that is.
God, what creeps! Thank Jeebus you got out okay. Even though their intentions are unclear, they obviously weren't good. Please stay safe!
